notes.border_note: Unlike p.ult and mine.ult, this dungeon uses the full 16x16 grid freely -- the outer border is NOT guaranteed to be solid wall. Many levels have floor, chests, or special cells in row 0, row 15, col 0, or col 15.
notes.shaft_note: 0x30 (ladder_up_down) at (5,5) appears on L5 and L6, forming a vertical shaft connecting those levels. L4(5,5)=ladder_down feeds into this shaft from above.
notes.fountain_encoding: 0x02 = fountain (subtype determined by game engine). 0x05 = mark (collectible item, identity engine-determined).
notes.sign_encoding: 0x08 = sign; each level uses clue string index N-1 (0-indexed). Sign cells often appear in symmetric clusters around key features (ladders, wind rooms).
